thread.title: Apple's stock surge to add nearly 60 points to the Dow's price - MarketWatch

author: Tomi Kilgore
title: Apple's stock surge to add nearly 60 points to the Dow's price - MarketWatch
text: Shares of Apple Inc. AAPL, +5.06% shot up 5.4% in premarket trade Wednesday, after the technology giant's fiscal first-quarter results , which were mixed but better than many had feared . The stock's price gain would add about 56 points to the Dow Jones Industrial Average's DJIA, +1.14% price, or more than half the Dow futures YMH9, +1.16% gain of 98 points, or 0.4%. Apple's stock is on track to open at the highest level seen during regular-session hours in six weeks, or Dec. 19. The stock has tumbled 27.5% over the past three months through Tuesday, while the Dow has slipped 1.2%.
